title: Asymptotic perimeter estimates for spirallike functions
summary: By a result of F. R. Keogh in 1959, we have the inequality $L(r,f)/M(r,f)\le 2π+4\log[(1+r)/(1-r)]$ for a starlike function $f$ on the unit disk, where $L(r,f)$ and $M(r,f)$ denote the length of the curve $θ\mapsto f(re^{iθ})$ and the maximum value of $|f(z)|$ on the circle $|z|=r$ for $0<r<1.$ E. Crane and D. Markose in their 2005 paper showed that the constant $4$ is best possible. D. K. Thomas obtained in 1968 the inequality $L(r,f)/\sqrt{A(r,f)}\le 2\sqrtπ(1+\log[(1+r)/(1-r)])$ for a starlike function $f$, where $A(r,f)$ is the area of the image of the disk $|z|<r$ under the mapping $f.$…
